name: MMBench: Multi-modal Model Evaluation Benchmark
description: MMBench is a comprehensive multi-modal evaluation benchmark containing 2,974 bilingual (English and Chinese) multiple-choice questions structured across 20 hierarchical perception and reasoning ability dimensions. Published at ECCV 2024, it incorporates CircularEval strategy (shuffling answer choices over multiple inference passes) to eliminate LLM choice-selection biases.
